subject: Invoice handoff: who triggers creation and where copies should land
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@brightco.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@brightco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — invoice format question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Our AP team is ready to take your invoices but we need two clarifications before we confirm the payment flow: 

1) Who at Redwood actually generates the final invoice file (PDF/UBL) — you (sales), a billing system, or should we pull from the portal?
2) If you send PDFs by email, can you include a single-line remit and PO reference in the subject line so our mail parser picks it up?

We can accept either method (email PDF or portal pull) but prefer portal API if available — it gives us automatic matching. Attached is our minimal invoice schema and an example (sample_invoice_template.pdf).

Also FYI, our preferred payment window is Net 45 but we can discuss Net 30 for the first invoice. 

Best,
Sasha Patel
Head of AP, BrightCo
attachments: sample_invoice_template.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@brightco.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — invoice format question

Hi Sasha — thanks for the clear note and the example. Looping in Kimberly (billing ops) and Connor (integrations) to confirm operational ownership. Quick answers up front: 

- Invoice generation: billing ops will issue the PDF and the system can push to your portal via SFTP/API. For customers who prefer, sales can also trigger a one-off PDF manually during onboarding.
- Subject line format: we can add the remit + PO ref to the email subject when we send PDFs; please confirm the exact subject token you want.

Kimberly / Connor — can one of you confirm the default path we should set for BrightCo in our onboarding checklist? We have two options:

A) Portal-first (recommended): set up portal/API access, Redwood emits canonical invoice JSON and PDF; BrightCo pulls via API or receives webhook.
B) Email-first fallback: Redwood emails signed PDF to accounts-payable@brightco.com with subject token (e.g., "INV:RDW-12345 | PO: <PO#> | remit: <entity>").

If BrightCo chooses A we will schedule a short integration call and share API keys; if B we need a `billing_sender` contact to sign off on the subject token.

Thanks — Rishi
Sales, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@brightco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Mar 2025 15:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — invoice format question

On Tue, Mar 18, 2025 at 10:03 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kimberly / Connor — can one of you confirm the default path we should set for BrightCo in our onboarding checklist? 

Hi all,

Thanks Sasha — and thanks Rishi for the context. For BrightCo I recommend we go with option A (Portal-first) but provision an email fallback for the first 60 days to avoid missed payments during the integration window. Implementation notes below: 

- Action owner: Kimberly (billing ops) — I'll own invoice issuance and the portal webhook setup.
- Portal artifacts: Redwood will emit JSON + signed PDF. We'll create a dedicated SFTP/API credential scoped to BrightCo and a token rotation schedule.
- Fallback email: once the invoice is emitted, an email copy will be sent to accounts-payable@brightco.com with subject pattern: "RDW-INVOICE | RDW-<invoice_no> | PO:<po_no> | remit:Redwood Inference". We can make that subject configurable per account.
- VAT/tax: BrightCo's schema shows reverse charge is possible — Sasha, please confirm tax stamping requirements.

Attachments: I attached our internal onboarding checklist and an example mapping (redwood-onboarding-steps.xlsx).

Next steps:
- Sasha: confirm preferred token for subject line and whether BrightCo wants AP pulls or we should push via webhook.
- Rishi: confirm contractual owner for invoice issuance (Sales vs Billing).
- Connor: advise estimated timeline for API key provisioning (ETA 3 business days after scoping call).

Kimberly Park
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-onboarding-steps.xlsx
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@brightco.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@brightco.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — invoice format question

Thanks Kimberly — that flow works for us. Quick confirmations: 

- We prefer portal-first with a 30-day fallback window (we can tighten later).
- Subject token: please use exactly "RDW-INVOICE | RDW-<invoice_no> | PO:<po_no> | remit:Redwood Inference" so our parser picks up fields reliably.
- Tax: BrightCo will process reverse charge where applicable; no special stamping required for invoices from Redwood.
- Contractually: invoice issuance should be owned by Billing Ops (Kimberly). Sales can trigger initial test PDF if needed.

We are OK with Connor provisioning API credentials after the integration call. Please send an invite for the integration session this week.

Cheers,
Sasha
Head of AP, BrightCo
-- End of thread --
